title: HogBoysLog
description: A modpack made for me and my friends which features a leveling system to make the game a tab bit more intriguing and some quality of life additions. (Work in progress)
body: This was a project that me and my friends wanted to put together as we felt other modpacks didn't feel special and were missing a little something, and that was exactly what we did in this pack. You can expect to see the base version of Minecraft overhauled as it takes longer to advance as EXP is vital to level up and progress. This pack can be challenging at times but that's the whole point as we don't want you to speed run through it and we want you to enjoy this vanilla+ experience. This pack has over 400+ mods and it’s still in development as you read this so we will be updating this pack regularly. You can also expect to see a variety of animals and mobs (naturalist). We have unique biomes thanks to Oh The Biomes We've gone + Terralith which you can find all of them using the nature compass mod and the Journey Map mod which will help you see all these different biomes. There are countless structures added with Yung’s + other mods as well. There are also many quality-of-life features, and it’s meant to be played with friends for a better experience but can be played solo as well.
